text:
Gold Price in 1980
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1980, the LBMA gold price fell 9.7% between 1980-01-31 ($653) and 1980-12-30 ($590). The highest sampled price was $667 in September and the lowest was $495 in March. The mean of these observations was $604. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 1980:
Gold and silver spiked to record highs in January 1980 amid double-digit inflation and the Hunt brothers' attempt to corner the silver market, then fell back sharply.
